payload.goal: Optimization technique for NVIDIA Hopper (H20 / H100 / H200 / SM90): Seesaw Pattern
payload.what: Two warp groups share the same output matrix (split into O_L and O_R by left/right halves) and alternate between using Tensor Cores and CUDA Cores:
payload.when: Two warp groups share the same output matrix (split into O_L and O_R by left/right halves) and alternate between using Tensor Cores and CUDA Cores:

implementation.snippet:
```
English description
WG0: [QK GEMM₀] [softmax₀] [QK GEMM₁] [softmax₁] ...
WG1:            [PV GEMM₀]             [PV GEMM₁] ...
      ↑ Tensor Core  ↑ CUDA Core  ↑ Tensor Core
```

```cpp
// WG0 execute QK GEMM(Tensor Core )
// WG1 execute softmax + scaling(CUDA Core )
__syncwarp();

// WG0 softmax(CUDA Core )
// WG1 PV GEMM(Tensor Core )
__syncwarp();
```
